source.correctionNotice: nflverse player stats update after game days. Wednesday night/Thursday may include NFL stat corrections. This site's Wednesday 8 a.m. Central policy can precede those corrections; each source timestamp identifies the evidence actually used.

limitations: Recent production is historical evidence, not a projection. Active-roster QB, RB, WR and TE candidates only; ties are retained and ordered by stable player ID.

Windows use each team's last three completed games, excluding byes. Per-game averages include all three team games. A missing player stat line contributes no recorded production and does not establish participation or availability.
Target share is player targets divided by all recorded team targets in the same games. Usage means recorded carries and targets, not snaps or routes.

backtest.method: Walk-forward Elo with preseason regression and neutral-aware venue adjustment; shared production scoring and a predeclared 80% vig-adjusted market blend. Historical rating warm-up begins in 1999; the documented development window is 2019 to 2023. Scenario sensitivities are not evaluated by this default-control backtest.
